description: React/TypeScript frontend for Lessons: a first-class FOURTH top-bar view (Record ⌘1 · Recordings ⌘2 · Lessons ⌘3 · Chat ⌘4) with library/catalog browse, lesson player, genuinely-interactive keyboard-accessible reduced-motion-aware explainers with per-lesson hero interactions, mastery dashboard with exam-readiness, final-exam flow with worked-solution reveal on every miss, spaced-repetition review surface, adaptive trainer, printable offline certificate, and the deferred Generate button as an honest 'coming soon' stub (no AI call). Plus the preview-only TS logic mirror and its node:test unit tests. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (Tauri commands) for real grading/data; uses FEAT-002 seed content at runtime. Independent of FEAT-004.
steps: Append-only shared-file edits for the fourth view: src/components/icons.tsx APPEND the 10 new icons (GraduationCapIcon, AtomIcon, FlaskIcon, ScaleIcon, RouteIcon, GaugeIcon, TrophyIcon, CertificateIcon, TargetIcon, ImportIcon — SparkleIcon already exists, reuse it) in the existing 24x24/currentColor/round-cap/strokeWidth=1.5 style. src/components/TopBar.tsx: add { mode: 'lessons', label: 'Lessons', shortcut: '⌘3' } to MODES and change Chat to '⌘4'. src/components/Shell.tsx: add 'lessons' to the AppMode union, render <LessonsView/> for it, and update the stale top-of-file 'one of three views' comment to 'one of four views (Record / Recordings / Lessons / Chat)'. src/App.tsx: add listen('menu:view_lessons', () => setActiveMode('lessons')) beside the existing menu:view_* listeners. src-tauri/src/menu_builder.rs: add VIEW_LESSONS = 'view_lessons', a Lessons menu item at CmdOrCtrl+3, change the Chat item to CmdOrCtrl+4, add the menu:view_lessons emit mapping and the enable-list/id-array entries (APPEND).

Create src/components/views/LessonsView.tsx (library + routing + Generate affordance), src/components/lessons/LessonLibrary.tsx (catalog list via lessons_list_catalog, 'Import a lesson…' via lessons_import_bundle with file/folder/URL, empty/loading/error states), src/components/lessons/GeneratePreview.tsx (the honest 'AI lesson generation — coming soon' panel per §12.3 — styled normally, not disabled/greyed/error; describes the future capability, says it will need Pro + an AI provider, points to Import + the seed course; makes NO AI call, NO entitlement check, NO network request), and src/components/lessons/Lessons.css (DESIGN.md semantic tokens only, bundled Inter only, no remote asset, prefers-reduced-motion). Add a 'Make lesson' action on a Class-type recording in the Recordings view that opens the same coming-soon preview and wires to no command.

Create src/lib/lessonLogic.ts (PREVIEW-ONLY mirror: numeric parse/compare hint, mastery preview, progress/resume — never authoritative, never decides pass/fail or writes a stored score) and src/lib/lessonLogic.test.ts in the node:test + node:assert style of src/lib/studyLogic.test.ts (import .ts with explicit extensions; runs under `npm test`, which is `TZ=UTC node --test src/lib/*.test.ts`).

Create src/components/lessons/LessonPlayer.tsx (sequenced explainers + worked-example step reveal + misconceptions + checkpoint; remediation routing deep-links each missed item to the first explainer tagged with its conceptIds, offers a targeted trainer and a retake) and src/components/lessons/explainers/ with one component per §6 kind: EquationBalancer (live per-element mass-balance meter + particle-count viz), MoleRatio (step reveal + live dimensional cancellation), LimitingReagent (before/after consumption bars), DimensionalAnalysis (drag tiles 'railroad' with live cancellation strike-through), MoleculeDiagram (SVG from structured data, keyboard-navigable atom list), TitrationCurve (draggable titrant slider, reduced-motion stepped), IdealGasPV (two coupled draggable variables), Misconceptions (flip/reveal cards), Figure ( from bundle bytes with alt-text + caption fallback on failed decode). Each: keyboard-operable, prefers-reduced-motion path, ARIA text-equivalent of the current interactive state, 2px focus ring, 4.5:1 contrast, 44px targets, and NO dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere.

Create src/components/lessons/ExamRunner.tsx (30-item flow via lessons_start_exam/lessons_submit_exam, numeric input, multistep, full worked-solution reveal on every miss), Dashboard.tsx (per-concept mastery bars, streak, exam-readiness meter with not-ready/almost/ready label, what-to-study-next), ReviewDue.tsx (SM-2 due surface via lessons_review_due), Trainer.tsx (adaptive drill via lessons_next_trainer_item/lessons_submit_trainer_item + full-solution reveal), Certificate.tsx (printable/exportable offline certificate in the hazard-yellow design language with the local verification hash, print-to-PDF + save dialog). All grading/scoring goes through the FEAT-001 Tauri commands (Rust authoritative); the TS mirror is live hints only.

Reuse study flashcard/quiz UI conventions from src/components/study/ (FlashcardDeck.tsx, QuizRunner.tsx, Study.css). Keep every Lessons surface on DESIGN.md tokens (no raw hex), sentence case, SVG icons only (no emoji), with empty/loading/error states.
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with zero type errors
`cd src-tauri && cargo build` and `cargo build --features mas` pass (menu_builder.rs change compiles)
Lessons is a fourth top-bar view at ⌘3 with Chat moved to ⌘4; the menu, Shell AppMode, and App.tsx listener all agree; the stale Shell.tsx 'three views' comment is updated
The Generate affordance opens a styled coming-soon preview and makes no AI/network/entitlement call (grep: no lessons_make_from_recording invoke)
grep finds no dangerouslySetInnerHTML under src/components/lessons/ or src/lib/lessonLogic*
Shared-file edits (icons.tsx, TopBar.tsx, Shell.tsx, menu_builder.rs) are append-style, not reordering existing entries
